title: Pick the Landing Square
setup: Your knight on e4 sits on the bishop's diagonal to h7, so every knight move it makes arrives with check.
hint: Every jump this knight makes opens the bishop's line. Only one of them also lands a hit on something.
explanation:
## The Idea

Any knight move uncovers the check, so the real question is which square earns material. {{Nd6+}} attacks the rook on c8 while Black deals with the check. After a king move such as {{Kg8}}, the knight collects it with {{Nxc8}}, and blocking with Rc2 only puts the rook where your bishop takes it.
